parsed.explanation: Structural signals are hostile. Gender-affirming surgery is criminalised for trans people (up to 10 years' imprisonment under Art. 8 of the 2018 medical liability law), and legal gender change is effectively blocked. The state has run a coordinated crackdown on LGBT activists, security forces coerced queer spaces to close, and a 2023 cybercrime law plus digital surveillance widen discovery and exposure. Social attitudes are hostile (93% oppose social acceptance of homosexuality, a general LGB measure). Same-sex decriminalisation is a tangential factor and is discounted. No documented trans-specific visitor exclusion, border mismatch rule, facility ban or trans-specific violence rate appears, and enforcement against foreigners is unsourced. The thin trans-specific record is extrapolated from the criminal care provision and the crackdown toward Elevated Risk, not the midpoint. Protective institutions are not documented.
